Extreme Learning Machines (ELMs) are feed-forward neural networks with a single hidden layer and random couplings, trained via linear regression, saving time and resources. Their quantum counterparts (QELMs) use a quantum reservoir to build complex representations of classical data, with inexpensive, noise-robust performance. The Quantum Theory Group at UNIPA has demonstrated the advantages of QELMs for validating and certifying quantum systems without tomographic reconstruction.
